directive: Use the attached standalone baseline and Notion designs. Implemented mathematical mechanisms are enabled by default, not excluded by a research/experimental label. Record any remaining execution/interface gap explicitly.
scope: Standalone implementation; no repository access requirement. Not an assertion of complete repository parity.

components.component: Single independent iGPU and physical host composition
components.detail: Native contract exists with no physical GPU; OpenCL actual kernels and authenticated remote agents are bound when configured.
Original exact host math retained; multi-limb GPU kernel compared on native C++ conformance path.

components.component: Lucas ladder and scaled workload windows
components.detail: L10,12,15,18,20,31,50,76,110; stream and clamp domain.
Complex128 Hermitian evolution, predicate oracle masks, Grover and phi feedback with explicit oracle counts.
Actual fold/checkpoint/coherence/Mandelbrot/interleave/eigensolve; actual predicate/hash fallback, not only stage labels.

components.component: Exact pair fold, selective unfold and native scale
components.detail: Explicit standalone sum/left rational encoding; full inverse and independent leaf restoration. Not an assertion of bitwise original PULVINI equivalence.
Unitary phase transforms and bounded lossless byte encoding are separate from exact algebra.

components.component: Prime-gap persistence, Infinity Fold, large logical addresses
components.detail: Finite durable payloads; symbolic 2^100+ addresses carry index and address expressions without allocating represented states.
Finite boundary bisection, escape score, normalization/finiteness checks.
CODATA registry and validated kernel-variable overrides; h changes normalized evolution time.
Bounded matmul/add/Hadamard/scale/Kronecker; shipped MPS gate execution with lossy rollback; original source retained.

components.component: 11D phi geometry and exact transport certificates
components.detail: Weighted norm, Poincare fold/inverse and IEEE64 Zeckendorf certificates; finite numeric view.

components.component: QX command buffer, weak measurement and barrier/descriptor execution
components.detail: Sealed commands, state allocation/evolution/correction/expectations, computational Kraus weak measurement.

components.component: Certified MLA ingestion and five retrieval views
components.detail: Rational complex exact state, folded state, Lucas/Binet/residual, prime/Zeckendorf/Cassini, M32 frame and lineage validate together.
Strict workload schema, quotas, request/result digests, tenant/global backpressure, auth and TLS remote binding.

components.component: GPU SHA256d, unchanged target and host candidate verification
components.detail: Actual two-pass kernel, exact prefix/nonce encoding; compile/source conformance passed. Physical execution requires GPU driver/device.

components.component: Swarm partition, vertical bounds, temporal pipeline
components.detail: Disjoint weighted nonce leases, bounded workers/inflight dispatch, device/kernel limits. Swarm local execution is CPU; remote/physical overlay is a separate bound fabric executor.

components.component: Guardian, genetic optimization and floor evaluator
components.detail: Epoch/deadline/ownership checks, observed rate promotion, bounded seeded evolution, SCALE1–SCALE10 report.
Packed shards+index, actual allocated-byte budget, circuit trace content addressing and replay; no per-witness Docker layer.

components.component: Hash-chain custody and optional HMAC evidence
components.detail: Work/backend/rung/partition/time evidence; trusted-head and signing-key validation; no hardware-root claim.

components.component: Paradigm thesis, schedule conformance and chaos
components.detail: User thesis retained; bijection/system/measurement/honesty gates all execute.
Real genesis block header, equal hash budgets, shuffled runs, independent hash crosscheck, negative outcomes retained.
Non-root, read-only container, TLS, private token, graceful signals, persistent volume; image build not executed on this host.

components.component: Native vendor/ASIC/MMIO/RTL execution and real sensor stack
components.detail: Inventory explicitly lists unbound direct CUDA/ROCm/Metal/ASIC/MMIO/RTL interfaces. Portable GPU binding uses OpenCL; these other executable drivers are not implemented in this standalone release.

components.component: Repository-specific Chronus-1 binary ISA, H4/600-cell fabric and TT/MPO extensions
components.detail: Source references retained for traceability. virtual_igpu_v1 is not a replacement binary ISA; M32/11D is not a 600-cell model; pair folds/MPS are not general TT/MPO. No repository prerequisite is imposed.
Offline header/target/lease execution only; no pool credentials, no network submission or acceptance claim.
Exact Q(phi), orbit-pair multiplication, trace/norm/Pell-Cassini checks, Zeckendorf/Binet certificate and triple-index identities.
Optional public framework bindings, actual CPU dense/ReLU ranker, exact candidate permutation checks; Apple hardware dispatch not executed on Linux.
Wheel/sdist metadata, CLI/doctor, platform-marked extras and 12-environment CI definition. Registry upload and multi-OS CI not executed.

components.component: ASIC-like prepared mining, fused scans and lanes
components.detail: Actual native portable-C/OpenSSL and explicit hashlib-copy paths; same exact digest/target; live epoch cancellation; bounded lanes, receipts and persistent progress.
Executed fake-driver conformance/tamper tests; no physical ASIC attached or measured.
Session bounded, tenant/request identity sealed, duplicate coalescing and no automatic replay of partial failure.
Bounded exact-input cache of positional dense ground-state ranking; fresh job/nonce mapping, norm/residual validation, cold solve and equal-work warm comparisons. Not a sparse solver.

Linear-storage tridiagonal minus rank-two solve, numerical lowest-root/inertia separation, residual validation, exact-input cache, explicit dense fallback for ambiguous order. Rung 18/31 full-pipeline cold and warm measurements both retained.
Two kernels, fp64 and launch bounds, host partial-dot reduction and numeric validation. Only native C++ syntax conformance here; not a full GPU eigensolver.

Domain-separated local canonical receipt, full 256-bit modular Fibonacci-matrix bijection, many-to-one bounded rung, exact family/prime certificate, local refusal, bounded coordinate adjustment. No consensus/testnet/mainnet deployment.

components.component: PYTHI-native security and physical proof obligations
components.detail: T1-T10 preserved with corrected signs/domain/pipeline/energy assumptions. No formal compiler, Sybil/reorg, hardware-throughput or erasure-energy proof claimed.

components.component: Target qualification command and genuine CI bindings
components.detail: Actual OpenCL identity/vector/mining profiling checks or refusal; real GITHUB_SHA/RUN_ID bindings only when supplied by executed CI. No physical device/runtime on current host.
PowerShell listings are retained, not treated as source or algorithms; exact API/byte ports of the listed modules require their specifications/source.

core_policy: Elevate the completed supplied core; do not rebuild or replace its exact sequence authority.
